changes: Author's name: 'śrīmanvādhavānanda' read as śrīman + Mādhavānanda (the 'nv' comes from the honorific śrīmat run into the name), so the stem is Mādhavānanda(rāja), not 'Manvādhavānandarāja'. Name given as Mādhavānandarāja, keeping the final -rāja, which may be an honorific.
as_written now gives the full form 'śrīmanvādhavānandarāja'.
Confidence lowered from high to medium because the reading is a correction.
Notes expanded: no scribe or date; the title is misspelled in the catalogue fields.

notes: This is only a chapter colophon (end of sarga 5). It names no scribe, owner or date and gives no place of copying. 'śrīmanvādhavānanda' is probably śrīman-Mādhavānanda: the honorific śrīmat has run into the name. The final -rāja could be part of the name or an honorific. 'subhāsābhūṣite' is probably subhāṣā-bhūṣite, meaning the text comes with a vernacular (bhāṣā) rendering. The catalogue title 'Sukhārṇāvārthaprakāśa' is misspelled for Sukhārṇavārthaprakāśa, as the colophon itself shows.
